stem: Priya is studying for her Science test at home in Pune. She reads that Amoeba takes in food and oxygen from the water around it, and pushes out wastes, through a thin outer covering that decides what may enter or leave the cell. Which main cell part is being described?

options.text: Cytoplasm, because many life processes happen inside it.
Nucleus, because it controls the activities of the cell.
Cell membrane, because it separates the cell and allows useful materials in and wastes out.
Cell wall, because it gives shape and support to the cell.

teacher.key_rationale: The job described is controlling what enters and leaves the cell and enclosing the cytoplasm and nucleus; this is the role of the cell membrane. Cytoplasm is where processes occur, the nucleus regulates activities and growth, and Amoeba has no cell wall, so the key is C.
